text.en: Atlas fossil evidence design study (DS01–DS04; docs/46). Five study groups, 33 selectable parts and one context platform, all original schematic geometry, no specimen scans or museum inventory. Twelve teaching modules are not twelve bones. Each study has its own scale and is baked into one shared display volume, not a physical scale. Ma means million years before present. Invented ash inputs L±eL / U±eU (Ma): wide 150.00±0.20 / 148.00±0.20; close 149.40±0.10 / 148.60±0.10; precise 150.00±0.05 / 148.00±0.05. For L>U>0 the central bracket is [U,L], width L−U, conservative outer envelope [max(0,U−eU),L+eL]. Outputs: wide 148.00–150.00, width 2.00, envelope 147.80–150.20; close 148.60–149.40, width 0.80, envelope 148.50–149.50; precise 148.00–150.00, width 2.00, envelope 147.95–150.05. Invented skeleton inventory: seven direct modules (skull, jaw, trunk, pelvis, left forelimb, both hindlimbs), three comparison modules (neck, ribs, right forelimb), two inferred tail modules. The directly recorded skull is displayed as a cast; neck is a cast of another specimen, ribs and right forelimb comparative sculptures, inferred tails sculptures, others represent originals. Whole/supported/direct shows 12/10/7; inventory stays 7/3/2. Not measurements. DESIGN/SIM, not measurements. Assumes upright undisturbed layers, primary ash, no fossil reworking, and relevant mineral crystallisation constrains deposition. Errors are invented bounded interval half-widths, not a probability distribution, a 95% confidence interval, or an assertion that real errors have strictly finite bounds. All three cases use identical section geometry: thickness is not time. Smaller errors keep the central 2.00 Ma gap; closer centres give 0.80 Ma. No mean-age, bone completeness, preservation probability, species identity or kinship is calculated. Values cannot date Prince, Apollonia or Twinky. Pores and mineral blocks are enlarged, with no microscopic scale, crystal identification, groundwater speed or replacement rate. Discrete hide/xray steps and camera easing show observations, not elapsed geological time. See text for all inputs, formulas, envelopes, 7/3/2 inventory and 12/10/7 visibility; all are invented.
text.zh: Atlas 化石证据设计研究（DS01–DS04；docs/46）。五组研究、33 个可选零件及一个背景底台，全为原创示意几何，无标本扫描或馆藏清单。十二教学模块不是十二块骨。各研究独立比例，烘焙到共用展示体积，不是物理比例。Ma 为距今百万年。虚构灰层 L±eL / U±eU（Ma）：wide 150.00±0.20 / 148.00±0.20；close 149.40±0.10 / 148.60±0.10；precise 150.00±0.05 / 148.00±0.05。L>U>0，中心夹定 [U,L]，宽 L−U，保守外包 [max(0,U−eU),L+eL]。结果：wide 148.00–150.00、宽 2.00、外包 147.80–150.20；close 148.60–149.40、宽 0.80、外包 148.50–149.50；precise 148.00–150.00、宽 2.00、外包 147.95–150.05。虚构骨架：七直接模块（头骨、下颌、躯干、骨盆、左前肢、两后肢），三比较模块（颈、肋、右前肢），两推定尾模块。直接记录头骨展示为复制件；颈为别个体复制，肋与右前肢为比较补塑，尾为推定补塑，其余代表原件。whole/supported/direct 显示 12/10/7，库存始终 7/3/2。非实测。 DESIGN/SIM，非实测。前提为正立未扰动、原生灰层、化石未再搬运，并把相关矿物结晶作为沉积约束。误差为虚构有界区间半宽，不是概率分布、95% 置信区间，也不是断言真实误差有严格有限界。三例剖面几何相同，层厚不是时间。较小误差保留 2.00 Ma 中心间隔，较近中心值给 0.80 Ma。不计算中点年龄、骨完整率、保存概率、物种身份或亲缘；不能给 Prince、Apollonia、Twinky 定年。孔隙与矿物块放大，无显微尺度、晶种、地下水速度或置换速率。离散显隐、透视和镜头缓动表示观察而非地质时间。全文列出各输入、算式、外包范围、7/3/2 库存与 12/10/7 显示数，均为虚构。
